arguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent animation sprite correction
Input images: Image 1 is the current approved polished SMDATE6 018 sprite and is the edit target. Image 2 is the original pose and component-boundary guide.
Primary request: Replace only the strange green leafy food bundle resting across the mermaid's two open palms with one clearly recognizable whole ripe mango.
Mango design: a compact natural oval mango, warm golden yellow-orange body with a restrained red blush on one side and a small muted green patch near the top; one tiny short brown-green stem is allowed; NO leaves, NO leafy bundle, NO second fruit, NO sliced fruit.
Composition: keep the mango in exactly the same hand-held area, supported horizontally by both low hands, at approximately the same overall scale as the existing food bundle.
Style/medium: match the established polished late-1990s cartoon sprite, bold clean black outline, smooth cel shading and highlights.
Constraints: Change only the food object and the minimum finger contact needed to hold it. Preserve pixel-for-pixel as closely as possible the approved mermaid identity, closed eyes, closed-mouth smile, head angle, face, hair, cyan headband, green swimsuit, torso, both arm positions, both hands, crop, proportions, line weight, colors, and genuine transparent RGBA background. Keep the mango fully visible and unmistakable. No tail, no water, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no extra objects.
